plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the Microsoft Privacy dashboard clone, focusing on settings toggles, data deletion flows, and the data download form across desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the main privacy dashboard to verify global navigation and activity cards. It will then deep-dive into the Browse History page to test filtering and destructive actions (single/bulk delete). Next, the run will cover Ad Settings to validate complex toggle interactions and interest selection. Finally, it will walk through the multi-step Download Data form and re-test critical interactive flows on a mobile viewport.
assumptions: Settings toggles provide immediate visual feedback (e.g., 'Saving...' or state change) rather than requiring a separate submit button.
'Clear all' in browse history and 'Clear' in the dashboard trigger modal dialogs requiring secondary confirmation.
Form submission on download-data.html provides success feedback but doesn't actually trigger a file download.
risk_hotspots: The 'Clear all' modal dialog in browse-history.html and any corresponding dialog on index.html.
Interaction between the master 'See ads that interest you' toggle and the service-specific toggles in ad-settings.html.
Small tap targets in the global navigation and header, especially on mobile.

phases.title: Dashboard & Navigation
phases.objective: Verify the main dashboard layout, global navigation links, and activity card entry points.
key_checks: Check functionality of global header links and user menu.
Interact with top-level 'Privacy settings' toggles and observe feedback.
Verify that 'Manage browse activity' and 'Download your data' buttons route to correct sub-pages.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated to browse-history.html, ad-settings.html, and download-data.html from the index.

phases.title: Browse History Management
phases.objective: Validate activity filtering and deletion interactions.
key_checks: Delete a single row using the per-row trash icon and observe animation/removal.
Click 'Clear all' and interact with the resulting modal confirmation.
exit_criteria: Filters manipulated, single row deleted, and 'Clear all' modal successfully confirmed or dismissed.

phases.title: Ad Personalization Settings
phases.objective: Test hierarchical toggle states and multi-select interactions.
key_checks: Toggle the master 'See ads that interest you' switch.
Toggle individual service switches (e.g., Microsoft consumer apps, Bing & Edge) and check dependency on master switch.
Select and deselect various 'Ad topics' checkboxes.
exit_criteria: Master toggle, sub-toggles, and interest checkboxes have been exercised and state changes verified.

phases.title: Data Download Flow
phases.objective: Complete the multi-step form to request a data archive.
key_checks: Select specific data categories (e.g., Account profile, Browse activity) instead of 'Include everything'.
Submit the form and observe success or validation states.

phases.title: Mobile Usability
phases.objective: Verify that complex layouts and dense navigation are usable on small screens.
key_checks: Check how the global navigation bar and 'small tap targets' adapt on mobile.
Verify that the activity card grid collapses properly on index.html.
Ensure data tables and filter bars in browse-history.html are usable without horizontal scrolling.
exit_criteria: Mobile layout assessed for overlap, horizontal scroll, and touch target size.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise settings toggles, modal dialogs, select dropdowns, and form submission.
coverage_targets.mobile: Re-run index navigation and browse history deletion flow on mobile viewport.

notes: Many small tap targets were flagged in the prescan; pay close attention to the top black ribbon and secondary nav usability, especially during the mobile phase.
